page.layout: One column of index lines, with letter headings E. and F. set apart. Running head "INDEX." at top. Catchword "Fere" at lower right.

main_text.l: Fabarum assiduus usus colicam & rutum [?] parit 240
Fagum primum mortalium fuisse victum pu-

page.notes: Running head "INDEX." and catchword "Fere" as printed. No page number printed. Fabarum line: "rutum" is unclear, possibly "rubum" or "rullum". Farfactitium: the second letter may be "s" ("Farfastitium"). The Ebrietati initial is a large E with a superscript B, read as "Ebrietati". The entry numbers 434 for Felis and 347 for Dysenteria are close in shape to each other. The Fagum entry's first line ends with a printed hyphen "pu-", and its number 131 stands beside the second line.
